requirement: The adapter shall deliver messages from the configured Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic to connected WebSocket clients without requiring clients to integrate the Pub/Sub API or SDK. Each running adapter instance shall share one Pub/Sub subscription across its connected clients, so subscription consumption depends on the number of running instances rather than the number of clients.

The adapter shall run as a containerized workload on Google Kubernetes Engine, using the Node.js pulltop process and websocketd to bridge Pub/Sub messages to WebSockets. Deployment shall use a billing-enabled GCP project and an identity with permission to read the configured topic and create Pub/Sub subscriptions.

Operators shall be able to select the Pub/Sub topic through a Kubernetes ConfigMap and supply that topic to the adapter runtime. Each independently configured deployment shall expose one WebSocket endpoint for one topic; serving additional topics shall use separate deployments.

The deployment shall expose the adapter through a Kubernetes LoadBalancer service that distributes client connections across running adapter instances, using external TCP port 80 and forwarding traffic to adapter port 8080.

The adapter shall retain up to the last 10 messages published to the configured topic and provide cached messages to newly connected clients, including during periods with little or no new message traffic.

The supplied deployment configuration shall include a CPU-based Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler targeting the adapter deployment, with a minimum of one replica, a maximum of two replicas, and a CPU utilization target of 80%.
